reference_eligibility.basis: Synthetic ground truth: no generated degradation episode overlaps 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-01. This is a property of the simulator, not an inspection record, and is not a model for how eligibility is established on real equipment.

attestations.declared_by: not applicable: synthetic data, no human review took place

label_semantics.onset_ts: simulated start of wear in the generator
label_semantics.fault_ts: simulated confirmed fault in the generator

data_exposure.declared_by: project team: this simulator family and these seeds have been inspected repeatedly

notes: Same calendar splits as the legacy synthetic experiment, run through the reviewed-data path with an explicit reference boundary. Its numbers are expected to differ from the legacy result, because the legacy mode's first-30-day and per-asset 21-day fitting assumptions are exactly what this path removes. Labels are split by scripts/split_episode_labels.py at validation_end; the synthetic label file had already been read in full before the split, so the split enforces the code boundary but does not make the synthetic test period untouched.
